sloka: प्रासं समाविध्य तदा ऽङ्गदाय समुज्ज्वलन्तं सहसोत्ससर्ज।स वालिपुत्रोरसि वज्रकल्पे बभूव भग्नो न्यपतच्च भूमौ ।। ६.६९.९२ ।।
transliteration: prāsaṁ samāvidhya tadā 'ṅgadāya samujjvalantaṁ sahasotsasarja।sa vāliputrorasi vajrakalpe babhūva bhagno nyapatacca bhūmau ।। 6.69.92 ।।

translations.english: Angada's head smashed by the blow of the fist of Naranthaka, hot blood flowed rapidly for a while. Recovering from delusion, gaining consciousness he wondered at the strength of Naranthaka.
